arcs: Procession-through-rooms (Cartier WAW 2025, LV Collectibles): the page is a sequence of self-contained worlds, one per hero object; scroll walks the visitor between them. webgpu.com describes the 2025 Cartier pavilion as 'six self-contained 3D alcoves, one per watch, that you scroll through like rooms in a very expensive museum after hours' — six equal self-contained rooms plus hidden gestures in every scene and a continuous Mooders score. No single climax: each room IS a contemplative peak and the momentum is the drift between them. (The 'no single climactic reveal' reading is an inference from the six-equal-rooms structure, not an award-body statement.)

Argument-scroll to a joining moment (Son Daven, award-verified SOTD): preloader Flip -> prologue -> place-tour proof beats with walk-time counters -> financials -> 'Become part of the legend' (the buy-moment framed as joining a heritage) -> contact rest. The one late climax fuses with the close; the whole spine between hero and close is kept alive by a scrubbed décor bed (the bed's interior numbers are executable defaults, not source-verified).

Editorial maison quiet-scroll (Delvaux, award-verified HM): slider hero -> triple-image swiper -> dual-image emblematic product -> tabular footer. Restraint is the register; commerce hides behind 'Discover'. This is the stillest arc — and it took the lower jury tier (HM) despite a very high community craft score.

Heritage-revival long-scroll (Urban Jürgensen): unconventional text-load entrance -> infinite vertical storytelling spine -> infinite horizontal product carousel -> rotatable 3D watch on the product page. Heritage told as an unbroken vertical surface that never bottoms out.
story.thread: The fil rouge is a single material treatment carried at one grade, hero to footer, and it is ALWAYS moving under the reader's hand — never a static motif. Pick ONE and commit it start to finish: (a) a continuous scored 3D drift where scroll IS the camera and each object gets its room (Cartier — GSAP + Lenis 'on the same nervous system', confirmed via webgpu.com); (b) a scroll-scrubbed parallax/film bed running UNDER the whole mid-page while fire-once reveals play over it (Son Daven — recommended recipe: ~five parallax layers at ease:none + a frame-sequence film at scrub:.25; interior numbers are executable defaults, not source-verified); (c) a living WebGL displacement ground that every image and the nav index sit on (Depo Luxe — reported virtual-scroll fusing scroll + render into one clock; mechanic not source-verified); (d) frosted-glass + hand-drawn craft skin that recedes so the product stays foreground (Brunello). The thread's amplitude stays LOW and reversible — the luxury tell is that the effect is felt, not announced. One grade page-wide, split by brand never within a page, never stock. On a multi-page maison (Delvaux, Urban Jürgensen, Brunello) the thread must survive the route change — carry it across navigations with a curtain/overlay wipe + loader re-entry (see gaps: route-transition-overlay), or the continuity law dies at the first page jump.
story.copy: Third-person inherited voice (founder maisons go first-person-plural). The words carry the story by naming the specific and refusing the transactional: one elevated tagline or one long lyrical sentence per surface; CTAs 2-4 words and invitational (Discover, Explore, Step inside, Become part of the legend) — never a price-forward or urgency CTA. Heritage signatures earned by a date ('The Oldest Fine Leather Goods House in the World' / 'Since 1829'; Urban Jürgensen leads on '250-year-old'). Sentence case except product names; tabular numerals for prices/editions/counts. Brunello lets a Kant/Socrates line stand in for product talk. The copy never feature-lists and never self-narrates the interaction.

spectacle_model.hero: The first viewport commits the material register and the entrance ritual, at a HIGH but never-loud amplitude. Three commit-shapes: (1) in-engine statement — a scored 3D room settles from the loader with no hard cut, hidden gestures live from frame one (Cartier, LV Collectibles, Depo Luxe SVG-fill dissolve); (2) eyebrow + display Flip-handoff — a real-progress preloader Flips its logo into the header, then the display type rises yPercent 250->0 behind a mask over ~1.2s easeOutQuart, a magnetic circular CTA with elastic.out(1,0.3) overshoot (Son Daven — these numbers are recommended defaults, not source-verified); (3) slider maison — visual + scrim, serif SplitText title up behind a mask (dur ~2, stagger ~.2, power4.inOut), roll-swap / stroke CTAs, figure clip-path:inset() wipe over ~1s (Delvaux — numbers carried from prior source reads, not re-verified this run). The hero is where first impression forms, but it is the OPENING of the thread, not a spent firework.
continuation: Cartier WAW 2025: after alcove one, the scored camera keeps drifting — five more self-contained 3D rooms dispose/load as you cross between them, each with its own drifting horizons / lapping water / theatrical mirrors and hidden gestures. Spectacle is DISTRIBUTED across all six rooms; the Mooders score is a continuous narrative layer, not wallpaper. Zero silence — the whole page is the spectacle. (Six-room structure + hidden gestures + continuous score confirmed via webgpu.com; exact per-scene transition timings not exposed.)

Prose stays alive via a scrubbed reading wash (chars from opacity:.1, re-firing every pass). Late spike at 'Become part of the legend'. The décor bed IS the continuation thread. spectacle_model.recommended_law: REFINE 'exactly one climax; peaks are capped, vocabulary is not' for corporate-luxury to: 'Peaks stay capped at 0-1 in the luxury register — but a continuous, LOW-amplitude, reversible signature thread must run under every viewport from hero to footer; the hero opens the thread, it never closes it. Going silent after the hero is a defect the jury reads as least-alive (Delvaux: very high community craft score, lowest award tier of the corpus). The luxury lever is the thread's AMPLITUDE (kept quiet, reversible, material — a scored 3D drift, a scrubbed parallax/film bed, a living WebGL displacement ground), never its peak count. Escalating peaks belong to other archetypes; corporate-luxury escalates presence, not volume.' Grounded on the confirmed six-equal-rooms structure of the canonical exemplar (Cartier 2025), LV Collectibles change-universe navigation between distinct environments, and Urban Jürgensen's never-bottoming infinite scroll; the Son Daven / Depo Luxe interior décor-bed mechanics that were extra support are demoted to executable defaults, not load-bearing for the verdict.

algorithm.decide: The one story the scroll tells
algorithm.rule: Pick exactly one of four arcs by brief: procession-through-rooms (object-first launch: watch/jewel/trunk reveal) -> Cartier/LV; argument-scroll-to-joining (investment/venture/heritage with an ask) -> Son Daven; editorial-maison-quiet-scroll (established house, commerce behind Discover) -> Delvaux; heritage-revival-long-scroll (revived/storied brand) -> Urban Jurgensen. The arc fixes the macrostructure and the climax count downstream; never blend two.
evidence: Cartier: six-rooms procession (confirmed via webgpu.com); Son Daven: 15+ section argument to 'Become part of the legend'; Delvaux: slider->swiper->product->footer; Urban Jurgensen: infinite vertical heritage spine (confirmed via awwwards description).

algorithm.decide: The signature thread (fil rouge) carried hero-to-footer
algorithm.rule: Choose ONE continuous material treatment and commit it under every viewport, at one page-wide grade, always moving under the hand: (a) scored 3D drift where scroll=camera (needs a WebGL path); (b) scroll-scrubbed parallax/film décor bed under the mid-page; (c) living WebGL displacement ground under all media; (d) frosted-glass + hand-drawn craft skin. Amplitude stays low and reversible. This decision is binding for every later section — every section either sits on the thread or advances it; no section is allowed to go inert. On a multi-page build, the thread must be re-entered across route changes (see step 4 + gaps: route-transition-overlay).
evidence: Cartier: GSAP + Lenis 'on the same nervous system', continuous Mooders score (confirmed via webgpu.com). Son Daven: reversible décor bed + idle marquee welded to wheel (executable defaults, not source-verified). Depo Luxe: reported virtual-scroll fusing scroll+WebGL into one clock (not source-verified). Brunello: frosted glass + hand-drawn recede so product stays foreground (makemepulse case study).

algorithm.rule: Map the arc to sections and place AT MOST one peak: procession = even-high intensity, no peak (each room is its own contemplative beat); argument-scroll = one LATE peak fused with the close (become-part-of-the-legend); editorial-maison = ZERO peak, even restrained intensity; heritage-revival = late 3D-object interaction as the only spike. Never a fold 'Shop now' CTA; never a product-card grid above the fold; the footer is tabular/contact-first, never a spectacle.
evidence: Son Daven: late join-the-legend fuses climax and close. Delvaux: no climax spike, restraint is the register. Cartier: no single climactic reveal (inference from six equal rooms).

algorithm.decide: Momentum map — what fills the gaps between peaks (and across routes)
algorithm.rule: Every viewport between hero and footer must carry the thread from step 2 PLUS a fire-once reveal on each content block. Minimum live channels at this tier = the thread (always-on, reversible) + fire-once block reveals + one hover/index channel; add a wheel-welded idle only where the register allows (skip it for the stillest editorial-maison, but know that costs award-tier). Reveals fire once (ScrollTrigger once:true); the décor thread re-fires every pass because it is décor over reading, not a reveal. Prose that must stay alive uses a scrubbed reading wash (chars from opacity:.1, top75%->bottom50%), NEVER a hover. On multi-page maisons, a route change plays a curtain/overlay wipe + loader re-entry that carries the thread across the navigation (see gaps: route-transition-overlay) — the single-scroll continuity model does not survive a page jump on its own.
evidence: Son Daven (award-verified): fire-once reveals + reversible décor bed + idle marquee; scrubbed reading wash on [data-highlight-text] (interior mechanics are executable defaults, not source-verified). Delvaux: no idle channel (inference) -> HM. Wheel smoothing is common across the corpus (Cartier GSAP+Lenis confirmed via webgpu.com; others plausibly via GSAP ScrollSmoother, untagged) — the prior revision's 'universal 5/5 (Lenis / ScrollSmoother / VirtualScroll)' was over-asserted and is dropped.

algorithm.rule: Pair the corpus reveal primitive to each section, changing axis/geometry per element but never the easing or primitive without a brief reason. Recommended easing default = easeOutQuart cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1) (a page-wide consistency default; the prior revision's 'byte-identical across Delvaux CSS var + GSAP CustomEase and Son Daven' was NOT re-verified from shipped CSS this run — see unverified); cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) easeOutExpo is the snappier alternate. Reveal primitive = reveal-from-behind-a-clip: masked translate for type, clip-path:inset() for media/overlays. Media reveals grayscale-first then colour floods late (image-curtain) when imagery is graded/archival.
evidence: Delvaux: figure clip-path:inset() ~1s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1); serif SplitText up behind mask dur ~2 stagger ~.2 power4.inOut (carried from prior source reads, not re-verified). Son Daven: display yPercent 250->0 ~1.2s easeOutQuart (recommended default, not source-verified).

algorithm.decide: Per-element interaction states (each element class gets its OWN geometry)
algorithm.rule: Never repeat one uniform hover across classes. CTA: roll-swap (two label copies, both translateY(-100%), no colour event) for editorial maisons, OR invert-to-solid-section-token (never rgba tint), OR line/stroke-draw (SVG ring or currentColor :before underline height .5px opacity 0->1) over photographic/3D surfaces. Link: colour cross-fade ink<->muted brand tone 1s + a 2px bullet dot fading in beside the label, OR an underline that appears (not grows). Figure: contained zoom scale(1.02-1.05) over 0.8-1.5s guarded by @media(hover:hover) for editorial figures — never a fast 1.1x snap; commerce product cards instead swap to a second angle or a short muted craft video on hover (see element_states.figure). Index row: spotlight-dim — hovered row lights, siblings drop to opacity:.2, metadata cross-fades in. Heading: masked per-line/per-word reveal only, zero font-variation-settings shift on hover. Cursor: over an interactive/hidden-gesture object the custom cursor morphs to a contextual label (HOLD/DRAG/VIEW/EXPLORE) so the gesture is discoverable (see element_states.cursor). Nav: the section's own colour faded in past a threshold, or backdrop-blur over <=5% tint, or a photographic scrim — NEVER a contrasting-accent border-bottom (the Delvaux same-ink <=3% hairline is the ONE sanctioned override, requires a written note).
evidence: Delvaux roll-swap CTAs + same-ink hairline nav; Son Daven invert-to-token CTA + magnetic circular CTA elastic.out(1,0.3) + per-char nav roll siblings-dim to .2; Brunello + Depo Luxe stroke/line CTAs; Depo Luxe index metadata cross-fade + backdrop-blur nav; LV Collectibles click-and-hold + Cartier hidden gestures require a contextual-label cursor to be discoverable.

algorithm.rule: Pointer classes go dormant on touch: magnetic cursor -> native, pointer-parallax off (depth comes from scroll), custom cursor scoped to WebGL surface only and its contextual-label affordance replaced by an on-object hint (icon/label). Scroll-driven thread STAYS (décor bed, clip reveals, WebGL ground, infinite scroll all work on touch). Figure hover-zoom -> tap opens the detail; commerce card second-image/video swap -> tap advances to the alternate view. CTAs answer the tap with a 90-160ms flash floor. Swipe-snap-gallery (native scroll-snap, next-cell peek) is the mobile gallery signature; drag surfaces set grab->grabbing. Bespoke soundscape stays behind a gesture-unlocked toggle.
evidence: Son Daven magnetic CTA native on touch; figure zoom @media(hover:hover); Depo Luxe audio behind toggle; swipe-snap-gallery = the scored Awwwards Mobile Excellence line.

algorithm.rule: Third-person inherited (founder brands first-person-plural). One elevated tagline OR one long lyrical sentence per surface. CTAs 2-4 words, invitational, never price/urgency. Earn superlatives with a date. Sentence case except product names; tabular numerals for prices/editions/counts. Imitate the SPECIFICITY of the corpus lines (the named place, the count, the refusal), never the wording. Never feature-list, never self-narrate the interaction.
evidence: Delvaux 'The Oldest Fine Leather Goods House in the World'; Son Daven 'investment project' / 'Become part of the legend'; Brunello Kant/Socrates line; Urban Jurgensen '250-year-old Swiss-Danish'.

pairs: cta-row -> masked-label-swap (roll) OR fill-invert-cta (solid token) OR line-draw-cta (over photo/3D)
section_playbook.states: The hero must be pointer-alive on desktop (a dead hero is a defect): CTA answers hover, media answers pointer where a magnetic/parallax layer exists. Opens the signature thread — the thread is live from frame one, never introduced later.
evidence: Son Daven preloader Flip -> display yPercent 250->0 (recommended defaults); Delvaux SplitText slider hero; Depo Luxe SVG-fill dissolve no hard cut.

forms: product-card (commerce: second-angle / muted-craft-video swap on hover)
pinned-media-stepthrough (pin + scrub — media held while captions/figures step over it)
section_playbook.states: Editorial figures answer hover with contained scale(1.02-1.05) + companion cue; commerce product cards swap to a second angle or a short muted craft video on hover; the scrubbed décor thread runs under the whole band; prose optionally carries a scrubbed reading wash.
evidence: Delvaux triple-image swiper + emblematic product (multi-page commerce); Son Daven place-tour with walk-time counters. Product-card second-image swap is the prevailing luxury e-com hover convention, not source-verified against a specific corpus card this run; pinned-media-stepthrough is a standard pin+scrub device the vocabulary otherwise lacks.

section_playbook.states: Hovered row lights with accent rule + surfaced/cross-faded metadata; siblings dim; on touch the row is a plain tap target. This is the primary interaction where a nav index is the page's spine.
evidence: Depo Luxe nav-index spotlight-dim + metadata cross-fade; Son Daven per-row spotlight.

section_playbook.states: In the procession arc each room is a contemplative beat at even-high intensity with hidden gestures live from frame one; scroll drives the camera; a scoped custom cursor over the WebGL surface only, morphing to a contextual label (HOLD/VIEW/DRAG) so the hidden gesture is discoverable.
evidence: Cartier six alcoves dispose/load between rooms, hidden gestures each scene (confirmed via webgpu.com); LV Collectibles click-and-hold + change-universe — both need a contextual-label cursor to surface the gesture.

section_playbook.states: The argument-scroll arc puts its ONE peak here (climax fused with close, intensity 9); other arcs keep the close quiet. One imperative, decisive channel rows, no media slot (the close cannot become a mood reel).
evidence: Son Daven legend-close intensity 9 fuses climax+close.

section_playbook.states: Tabular/contact-first carrying the maison tagline; rest, never a spectacle. Palette may flip once at the very close but stays legible in both states.
evidence: Delvaux newsletter+accordion+'Oldest Fine Leather Goods House'; Son Daven sales departments by city; Depo Luxe signed oversized wordmark.

cta.hover: Editorial maison: label roll-swap — two label copies in an overflow:hidden clip both translateY(-100%) together, transform ~.2s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), NO colour event (Delvaux, Son Daven). Weighty hero CTA: invert to the SOLID section token, geometry extended -4px past the label with a 2px outline in the bg colour, never rgba(token,0.1) (Son Daven). Over photography/3D: line/stroke-draw — draw an SVG ring OR fade a currentColor :before underline at height:.5px opacity 0->1 (Brunello, Depo Luxe). Magnetic circular CTA translates toward the pointer, springs back elastic.out(1,0.3) (Son Daven; amplitudes are recommended defaults, not source-verified).
cta.tap: Fill/roll fires on :active as the tap answer, 90-160ms flash floor; magnetic pull is native on touch.
cta.focus: :focus-visible mirrors the hover state (roll/fill/draw all reachable by keyboard); never hover-only.

link.hover: Colour cross-fade ink <-> muted brand tone, color 1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), with a 2px bullet dot fading in beside the label (Delvaux); OR a currentColor :before underline that APPEARS opacity 0->1 over .1-.2s rather than growing from a point (Depo Luxe). Never a fast underline slide.
link.tap: Underline/dot in its resting-present state; the tap navigates.
link.focus: :focus-visible shows the same accent + underline; underline is present, not animated, for reduced-motion.

figure.hover: Editorial figure: contained zoom scale(1.02-1.05) over 0.8-1.5s on the corpus easing, guarded by @media(hover:hover) — never a fast 1.1x snap. Companion cue: caption rise, scrim lift, or grayscale->colour bloom. Delvaux's only zoom in the whole sheet is scale(1.02) on a swatch. Commerce product-card variant: on hover the card swaps to a second angle OR a short muted craft/artisan video (secondary-image-on-hover, the prevailing luxury e-com convention for the corpus's commerce grids — Delvaux, Urban Jürgensen, Brunello; crossfade ~.3-.5s, first frame preloaded, video muted+loop+playsinline, guarded by @media(hover:hover)). The card swap is a convention, not source-verified against a specific corpus card this run.
figure.tap: Tap opens the detail / enlarges; commerce card tap advances to the alternate view; the resting figure is fully legible with no hover.
figure.focus: focus-within triggers the same cue so keyboard users reach the caption / alternate view.

index_row.hover: Hovered row lights (accent rule + surfaced metadata); siblings drop to opacity:.2; Depo Luxe additionally cross-fades the hovered row's metadata (client/counter fade out as director/title arrive).
index_row.tap: Plain tap target — no dim; the row navigates.
index_row.focus: :focus-visible lights the focused row identically; the dim is decorative and never hides content.

heading.hover: None — headings do not answer the pointer. Zero font-variation-settings shift on hover across every readable sheet.
heading.focus: Entrance only: masked per-line (SplitText under overflow:hidden, sliding up, power4.inOut dur ~2 stagger ~.2) or per-word scatter-in (alternating yPercent) — fire-once, never per-letter typewriter.

cursor.hover: Over an interactive / hidden-gesture object the custom cursor morphs to a contextual label (HOLD / DRAG / VIEW / EXPLORE) plus a shape shift (grow, or an outline ring), making luxury's hidden gestures discoverable. Scoped to the interactive or WebGL surface — the default cursor returns off the surface. This is the affordance that surfaces the confirmed gestures (LV Collectibles click-and-hold, Cartier hidden gestures); listing the gesture without it leaves it undiscoverable.
cursor.tap: No custom cursor on touch — native pointer. The gesture is surfaced instead by an on-object hint (icon or short label) since there is no hover to reveal it.
cursor.focus: Keyboard reaches the gesture via focus + Enter/Space; the contextual label has an accessible-name equivalent (aria-label / visually-present hint) so it is not pointer-only.

nav.hover: Per-char roll-swap on nav labels staggered {each:.025, from:'random'} with siblings spotlight-dimmed to .2 (Son Daven). Surface flips with the section: the section's own colour faded in past a scroll threshold (Son Daven), OR backdrop-filter:blur(40px) over a <=5% tint (Depo Luxe), OR a photographic top-down gradient scrim (Brunello). NEVER a contrasting-accent border-bottom; the Delvaux same-ink border-bottom:1px rgba(29,29,27,.03) ~3% hairline is the ONE sanctioned exception, requires a written override.
nav.tap: Hamburger / plate answers the tap; the surface tint is the resting state, no blur required (two of four winners use no blur at all).
nav.focus: Nav links keep a clean accessible name (aria-label); :focus-visible shows the roll target string.

mobile_answer: The scroll-driven signature thread is the touch strategy — it is what survives the pointer going dormant. On touch: magnetic cursor -> native, pointer-parallax OFF (depth comes from scroll), any custom cursor scoped to a WebGL surface only and its contextual-label affordance replaced by an on-object hint. The décor bed, clip/curtain reveals, WebGL displacement ground, infinite scroll and scored 3D drift ALL work on touch because they are scroll-driven, so the continuation thread is never lost on mobile. Figure hover-zoom degrades to tap-opens-detail; commerce card second-image/video swap degrades to tap-advances-view; CTAs answer :active with a 90-160ms flash floor; index rows become plain tap targets (no sibling dim). swipe-snap-gallery (native OS-momentum scroll-snap, next-cell peek, enhancer-fed dots) is the mobile gallery signature and the scored Awwwards Mobile Excellence line; drag surfaces set grab->grabbing. Bespoke soundscape stays behind a gesture-unlocked toggle. On multi-page maisons the route-transition overlay still fires on touch (it is scroll/time-driven, not pointer-driven) so the thread survives navigation. Evidence: Son Daven magnetic CTA native on touch + figure zoom under @media(hover:hover); Depo Luxe audio toggle; Cartier/Depo Luxe scroll-camera and WebGL ground are inherently touch-scrollable.

gaps.mechanic: The CTA move for photographic / 3D / frosted surfaces where a fill or roll would be too heavy: on hover/focus, either stroke-draw an SVG ring around a circular CTA (stroke-dashoffset animating to 0 over ~.6-.8s on the corpus easing) OR fade in a currentColor :before underline at height:.5px, opacity 0->1 over .1-.2s. No fill flood, no colour flip of the label. Reduced-motion: the underline/ring is present at rest. The manifest has fill-invert-cta (flood) and masked-label-swap (roll) but no drawn-line option — and corporate-luxury lives on photography/3D where those two read as too loud.

seen_in: Son Daven (SOTD Jun 2026, award-verified; interior numbers not source-verified)
gaps.mechanic: The executable form of the continuation law: a reversible, scroll-scrubbed multi-layer parallax/film bed that runs UNDER the whole mid-page while fire-once reveals play over it. 3-5 [data-depth] layers translate at differential rates ease:none tied to ScrollTrigger scrub, optionally a frame-sequence film at scrub:.25 and a WebGL blackPoint/whitePoint grade; compositor-only (transform/opacity), pauses off-screen. Distinct from pointer-parallax (pointer-driven, fine-pointer only, dormant on touch) — this is SCROLL-driven, always-on, and works on touch. This is THE mechanic the manifest cannot execute for the mandatory low-amplitude continuation thread.

seen_in: Delvaux (HM Jun 2026, multi-page commerce; 51North case study: 'dynamic transitions... unify product categories')
Urban Jürgensen (SOTD Oct 2025, PDP + product pages)
gaps.mechanic: The mechanic that keeps the signature thread alive across a page navigation on multi-page maisons — the continuity law the playbook otherwise models only as one continuous scroll. On a route change, intercept the default navigation (Barba.js / Taxi.js-style: preventDefault, animate out, fetch + swap the container, animate in), playing a full-bleed curtain/overlay wipe (clip-path:inset() sweep or a transform panel that covers then uncovers) with a brief loader re-entry that re-establishes the thread (décor bed / WebGL ground / scored drift) on the incoming page. Compositor-only, ~.6-1s. Reduced-motion: instant container swap with a short cross-fade. Without it the continuation thread dies at every navigation on the 3 of 8 corpus sites that are multi-page commerce.

Scroll-scrubbed camera procession through discrete self-contained 3D scenes/alcoves (one per hero object), scenes dispose/load as you cross between them, GSAP + Lenis on one clock, a continuous scored soundscape as a narrative layer, and hidden gesture reveals live in every scene. The canonical exemplar of the whole archetype has NO buildable recipe in recipes.json (engine-world-depoluxe is a folio, not a pavilion) and no component for the multi-scene camera glide with per-scene hotspots. Delegated to webgl-scene today; needs a named corporate-luxury cinematic-pavilion recipe + a scene-procession spec so the pattern is composable, not just possible. (2025 six-alcove structure + hidden gestures + score confirmed via webgpu.com; per-scene transition timings not exposed.)

A custom cursor that morphs to a contextual label (HOLD / DRAG / VIEW / EXPLORE) plus a shape shift (grow / outline ring) when over an interactive object, making luxury's 'hidden gestures that reward curiosity' discoverable. Scoped to the interactive / WebGL surface, default off-surface; dormant on touch (native pointer, gesture surfaced by an on-object hint instead); keyboard reaches the gesture via focus + Enter/Space with an accessible-name equivalent. The playbook scopes the cursor to the WebGL surface but never encodes the label-morph affordance — so the two exemplars' confirmed gestures are undiscoverable. This is the affordance the manifest is missing, distinct from a plain magnetic cursor.

A luxury gesture primitive: press-and-hold on an object charges a progressive reveal (open the trunk / rotate into detail / dissolve to the next universe), with a radial or linear progress cue that fills over the hold (~600-900ms) and completes or reverts on release. Pointer + touch (pointerdown/pointerup, cancel on leave). Keyboard equivalent: Enter/Space hold or a single activate. No manifest component covers a hold-to-charge gesture; scrub-film is scroll/pointer-mapped, not press-charged.

Seamless infinite vertical storytelling spine and/or infinite horizontal product carousel that never bottoms out — content recycles so the scroll (and therefore the signature thread) never rests. Momentum-preserving, index-mapped, respects reduced-motion by falling back to a finite track. swipe-snap-gallery is finite native-snap; there is no looping/recycling track in the manifest.

variation: This section_playbook is one legal costume of the archetype, never THE skeleton. Structure is story-native (SKILL.md Phase 1): the body's sections derive from the universe's spine, then check against these roles for coverage — never the reverse. The axes serial winners measurably rotate between builds (21-artifact corpus, 5 studios): body content archetype + item counts, the ONE signature device (never reused across builds), the close mechanism, the hero medium, the index/HUD costume. What persists as DNA: type grammar, the motion register (the register itself, never the named reading/interaction kit — that kit is a device, rotated per build like the signature), annotation grammar as a form, engineering architecture. The same content archetype + item count + close mechanism recurring across two different-brand builds has zero winner precedent.
